items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I know a fella not who's playing left hand... Bill Jennings.

ctx.x: Uh, uh, uh, uh, Kimble. Oh, Kimble? Kimble played left hand guitar. Is that right? Yeah. I didn't know.
I know a fella not who's playing left hand. He's not from here. Yeah. Yeah. He played with a band out of New Orleans. Rob Brown, he was playing with Rob Brown. Oh, yeah. Bill Jennings.
What does he do? Have to change the strings entirely from high to low?
